H04_ext_absolute_pose_probe.pre_registered: sufficiency: GT pitch std <0.05 UNDERPOWERED / 0.05-0.15 MARGINAL / >=0.15 SUFFICIENT; accuracy: pooled sign-fixed |r| >=0.30 PASS / 0.15-0.30 PARTIAL / <0.15 FAIL (class floor max|r|=0.117)
H04_ext_absolute_pose_probe.finding: FAIL: absolute real-domain pose accuracy NOT recovered — H04's 5-class structure is an OOD category/activation probe, not pose. Geometry limit (recorded): iris plane normal carries |pitch| and sum(yaw+torsion) only; torsion not individually separable. G14 input spec fixed: absolute pose needs paired RGB+real depth with per-frame real pose reference (TEyeD cannot supply alone).
